name: debugging
description: Systematic debugging: root cause before any fix — reproduce first, read the actual error, isolate with hypothesis tests and bisection, one change at a time, verify against the original symptom; escalation rule after three failed fixes. Ships a delegatable debugger agent for handing off the long reproduce-bisect investigation. Includes /debugging:debug.

cc_remind.title: Reminder hooks (CC_REMIND)
cc_remind.description: Reminder hooks that add guidance to the session: on or off. The environment variable CC_REMIND overrides this. Set in the shell, the variable mutes every plugin at once, while this option mutes only this plugin.
